a.cara-convert-heic-ke-jpg.title: Uko wahindura HEIC ukayigira JPG kuri telefone no kuri mudasobwa (ku buntu, nta porogaramu)
a.cara-convert-heic-ke-jpg.excerpt: Amafoto ya iPhone muri HEIC ntafunguka kuri Windows cyangwa Android? Hindura HEIC ukayigira JPG mu masegonda make, ku buntu kandi udashyize amafoto kuri seriveri.
a.cara-convert-heic-ke-jpg.body:
iPhone ibika amafoto mu buryo bwa HEIC kuko ingano yayo iba ntoya kurusha JPG, ubwiza bukaba bumwe. Ikibazo ni uko ibikoresho na porogaramu nyinshi, cyane cyane Windows ya kera, Android n'imbuga za interineti, bitabasha gufungura HEIC. Igisubizo cyoroshye kurusha ibindi ni guhindura HEIC ukayigira JPG.

Ukoresheje I Need Convert, ushobora kubikora ako kanya muri browser. Amafoto ntashyirwa kuri seriveri iyo ari yo yose, bityo agumana ibanga ryayo.

HEIC ni iki?

HEIC (High Efficiency Image Container) ni uburyo bugezweho bwo kubika amafoto Apple imaze gukoresha kuva kuri iOS 11. Bushobora kubika amafoto afite ingano igera ku mubare w'igice cya JPG, bugashyigikira amafoto ya Live n'amabara menshi kurushaho. Ku bw'amahirwe make, ntiburashyigikirwa hose.

Uko uhindura HEIC ukayigira JPG

  1. Fungura ineedconvert.com muri browser ya telefone cyangwa ya mudasobwa yawe.
  2. Kanda kuri Hitamo dosiye, hanyuma uhitemo ifoto imwe cyangwa nyinshi za HEIC icyarimwe.
  3. Kuri buri dosiye, hitamo ubwoko bwa JPG mu rutonde rumanuka.
  4. Kanda kuri Hindura cyangwa Hindura zose.
  5. Amafoto ya JPG ahita yimukira ku gikoresho cyawe.

Inama: Ukeneye inyuma hadafite ibara (transparent)? Hitamo PNG. Ushaka dosiye ntoya cyane yo kohereza kuri chat? Hitamo WEBP.

Uko wakora ngo iPhone ihite ibika JPG

Niba ushaka ko iPhone ifotora ihita ibika JPG, fungura Igenamiterere → Kamera → Formats, hanyuma uhitemo Most Compatible. Amafoto azakurikiraho azabikwa nka JPG, ariko ingano yayo izaba nini gato.

Ibibazo bikunze kubazwa

Ubwiza bw'ifoto buragabanuka?

Itandukaniro ntirigaragara hafi na rimwe. JPG ibikwa ku bwiza bwa 92%, buhagije ngo ifoto icapwe cyangwa ishyirwe ku mbuga nkoranyambaga.

Nshobora guhindura amafoto menshi icyarimwe?

Yego. Hitamo cyangwa ukurure amafoto yose uyashyire mu gasanduku k'uguhindura, hanyuma ukande kuri Hindura zose.
a.cara-ubah-video-jadi-mp3.title: Uko wahindura videwo ukayigira MP3 nta porogaramu
a.cara-ubah-video-jadi-mp3.excerpt: Kura ijwi muri videwo ya MP4, MOV cyangwa MKV ukaribika nka MP3 y'ubwiza bwa 192 kbps. Ku buntu, vuba kandi muri browser.
a.cara-ubah-video-jadi-mp3.cap0: Kumva umuziki ukoresheje ibyuma bikinishwa mu matwi.
a.cara-ubah-video-jadi-mp3.body:
Rimwe na rimwe ukenera ijwi gusa: amajwi y'ikiganiro, podikasiti yo kuri videwo, imyitozo y'umuziki cyangwa amajwi y'inama. Aho gushyiraho porogaramu yiyongera, ushobora guhindura videwo ukayigira MP3 ako kanya kuri I Need Convert.

Intambwe zo gukurikiza

  1. Fungura urupapuro rw'uguhindura maze ukande kuri Hitamo dosiye.
  2. Hitamo videwo (MP4, MOV, MKV, WEBM, AVI n'izindi).
  3. Mu rutonde rw'ubwoko, hitamo MP3.
  4. Kanda kuri Hindura hanyuma utegereze ko akabari kerekana aho bigeze karangira.
  5. Dosiye ya MP3 ihita ibikwa mu bubiko bwa Downloads.

Igihe uhinduye videwo cyangwa amajwi ku nshuro ya mbere, browser ikenera gupakira porogaramu ihindura ingana na MB 30 hafi. Nyuma yaho, guhindura bikurikiraho birihuta cyane.

Hitamo ubwoko bw'amajwi bukwiye

  • MP3: ihuza n'ibikoresho byinshi cyane, ishobora gukinishwa ku gikoresho icyo ari cyo cyose.
  • M4A / AAC: ingano ntoya n'ubwiza bwiza, ikwiriye iPhone. Muri videwo ya MP4, ijwi rishobora kwigana nta guhindurwa bundi bushya, bityo bigakorwa hafi ako kanya.
  • WAV / FLAC: nta gukanda byangiza ubwiza, bikwiriye gutunganywa.
  • OPUS / OGG: bifite ubushobozi bwinshi ku majwi y'abantu bavuga.

Inama: Ku majwi uzongera gutunganya, abanza ubibike nka WAV, hanyuma uyahindure MP3 nurangiza gutunganya.

Koresha neza

Menya neza ko ufite uburenganzira kuri videwo uhindura. Ku bikubiyemo iby'abandi, ubikoreshe gusa ku mpamvu zawe bwite kandi wubahe uburenganzira bw'uwabikoze.
a.cara-convert-pdf-ke-word.title: Uko wahindura PDF ukayigira Word (DOCX) ku buntu kandi mu mutekano
a.cara-convert-pdf-ke-word.excerpt: Hindura inyandiko iri muri PDF ikabe inyandiko ya Word ushobora guhindura. Nta kwiyandikisha, nta kimenyetso (watermark), kandi dosiye ntishyirwa kuri seriveri.
a.cara-convert-pdf-ke-word.body:
PDF ni nziza gusoma no gusangiza abandi, ariko biragoye kuyihindura. Niba ukeneye gufata ibiri muri PDF ukongera ukabihindura, inzira yihuta cyane ni guhindura PDF ukayigira Word (DOCX).

Uko uhindura PDF ukayigira DOCX

  1. Fungura I Need Convert hanyuma uhitemo dosiye ya PDF.
  2. Hitamo ubwoko bwa DOCX.
  3. Kanda kuri Hindura, hanyuma ufungure igisubizo muri Microsoft Word, Google Docs cyangwa WPS.

Inyandiko yo kuri buri paji irakurwamo ikongera igategurwa mu bika ushobora guhita uhindura.

Ibyo ugomba kumenya

  • PDF zakorewe scan ziba zigizwe n'amashusho, atari inyandiko. Muri izo PDF, inyandiko ntishobora gukurwamo hatabayeho OCR.
  • Imiterere y'inyandiko igoranye nk'inkingi nyinshi, imbonerahamwe n'amashusho ntiyimukira buri gihe. Uku guhindura kwibanda ku nyandiko ubwayo.
  • Niba ukeneye inyandiko yoroheje gusa, hitamo ubwoko bwa TXT.

Inama: Ushaka kubika isura ya PDF nk'uko iri? Hindura PDF ukayigira PNG cyangwa JPG, ifoto imwe kuri buri paji. Ubusobanuro buri mu nyandiko yitwa uko wahindura PDF ikaba amafoto.

Kuki bifite umutekano kurushaho?

Inyandiko nk'amasezerano, inyemezabwishyu y'umushahara cyangwa indangamuntu ntizikwiye gushyirwa ku mbuga zose. Kuri I Need Convert, ibikorwa byose bibera ku gikoresho cyawe, bityo inyandiko ntizigera zive kuri telefone cyangwa kuri mudasobwa yawe.
a.cara-convert-pdf-ke-jpg.title: Uko wahindura PDF ikaba amafoto ya JPG cyangwa PNG
a.cara-convert-pdf-ke-jpg.excerpt: Buri paji ya PDF iba ifoto isobanutse. Yikurure imwe imwe cyangwa zose icyarimwe muri dosiye imwe ya ZIP.
a.cara-convert-pdf-ke-jpg.body:
Kohereza PDF kuri chat rimwe na rimwe biragora kuko uyihawe asabwa gufungura indi porogaramu. Guhindura PDF ikaba amafoto bituma ibiyirimo bihita bigaragara, bigasangizwa kuri status cyangwa bigashyirwa muri presentation.

Intambwe zo gukurikiza

  1. Fungura I Need Convert hanyuma uhitemo dosiye ya PDF.
  2. Hitamo ubwoko bwa JPG, PNG cyangwa WEBP.
  3. Kanda kuri Hindura.
  4. Kuramo buri paji ukwayo, cyangwa ukande kuri Kuramo zose kugira ngo paji zose zibikwe muri ZIP imwe.

Paji zishushanywa ku buryo bw'incuro ebyiri z'ubusobanuro busanzwe, bityo inyandiko ikomeza gusobanuka iyo uyizamuye.

JPG, PNG cyangwa WEBP?

  • JPG: ingano ntoya, ikwiriye inyandiko zifite amafoto cyangwa kohereza kuri chat.
  • PNG: isobanutse cyane ku nyandiko n'ibishushanyo, ariko ingano ni nini.
  • WEBP: impuzandengo nziza hagati y'ubusobanuro n'ingano.

Haracyari urujijo? Soma itandukaniro rya JPG, PNG na WEBP.
a.perbedaan-jpg-png-webp.title: Itandukaniro rya JPG, PNG na WEBP: Hitamo ubwoko bw'ifoto bukwiye
a.perbedaan-jpg-png-webp.excerpt: Ni ryari ukoresha JPG, ni ryari PNG, kandi ni ryari WEBP? Menya ibyiza n'ibibi bya buri bwoko kugira ngo amafoto yawe agume asobanutse kandi yoroheje.
a.perbedaan-jpg-png-webp.body:
Ubwoko bw'ifoto bukwiye bushobora gutuma dosiye iba ntoya cyane nta tandukaniro rigaragara. Dore itandukaniro ry'ubwoko butatu bukoreshwa cyane.

JPG

JPG ikoresha gukanda kwa lossy, bivuze ko bimwe mu bisobanuro bivanwamo kugira ngo dosiye ibe ntoya. Ikwiriye cyane amafoto, ariko si nziza ku nyandiko, ibirango (logo) cyangwa amafoto y'ecran kuko impande zishobora kugaragara zitameze neza. JPG ntishyigikira inyuma hadafite ibara (transparent).

PNG

PNG ikoresha gukanda kwa lossless, bityo nta gisobanuro gitakara. Ni cyo gihitamo cyiza ku mafoto y'ecran, ibirango, utumenyetso n'amafoto afite inyuma hadafite ibara. Ikibazo ni uko amafoto asanzwe muri PNG ashobora kuba manini cyane.

WEBP

WEBP ni ubwoko bugezweho bwa Google bushyigikira gukanda kwa lossy na lossless, ndetse no kutagira ibara inyuma. Akenshi iba ntoya ho 25–35% kurusha JPG, ubwiza bukaba bungana. Ikwiriye imbuga za interineti no kohereza kuri chat.

Incamake

  • Amafoto yo gucapa cyangwa kohereza: JPG.
  • Ibirango, utumenyetso, amafoto y'ecran: PNG.
  • Amafoto y'imbuga za interineti: WEBP.
  • Agashusho k'urubuga (favicon): ICO.

Inama: Ubwoko bwose bwavuzwe haruguru bushobora guhindurwa hagati yabwo kuri I Need Convert, harimo no kuva kuri HEIC, BMP, TIFF na SVG.
a.cara-convert-mov-ke-mp4.title: Uko wahindura MOV ukayigira MP4 nta kugabanya ubwiza
a.cara-convert-mov-ke-mp4.excerpt: Videwo ya MOV iva kuri iPhone cyangwa kuri kamera ntikinwa ku bikoresho byose? Yihindure MP4 mu masegonda make nta guhindurwa bundi bushya.
a.cara-convert-mov-ke-mp4.cap1: Kamera ya telefone na kamera ya digitale.
a.cara-convert-mov-ke-mp4.body:
MOV ni ubwoko bwa videwo busanzwe kuri iPhone no ku makamera menshi. Ku bw'amahirwe make, porogaramu zimwe, televiziyo n'imbuga ntizibushyigikira. MP4 ni ubwoko butekanye kurusha ubundi kuko bukinishwa hafi hose.

Uko uhindura MOV ukayigira MP4

  1. Fungura I Need Convert hanyuma uhitemo videwo ya MOV.
  2. Hitamo ubwoko bwa MP4.
  3. Kanda kuri Hindura, hanyuma utegereze ko birangira.

Kuki bishobora kwihuta cyane?

MOV na MP4 mu by'ukuri ni «ibikoresho» gusa. Ibibirimo, ari byo videwo ya H.264/HEVC n'amajwi ya AAC, akenshi biba bimwe. I Need Convert ibanza kugerageza kwimura videwo mu gikoresho gishya nta guhindurwa bundi bushya. Igisubizo kiba hafi ako kanya kandi ubwiza buba bungana 100% n'ubw'umwimerere.

Iyo ibiri muri videwo bidahuye n'igikoresho cyifuzwa, videwo ihita ihindurwa bundi bushya muri H.264 kugira ngo irusheho gukinwa.

Inama: Uburyo bumwe bukora no kuri MKV ijya muri MP4, MP4 ijya muri MOV, na TS ijya muri MP4.

Ubundi bwoko bwa videwo

  • WEBM: ikwiriye imbuga za interineti.
  • MKV: ishyigikira inyandiko nyinshi z'ubusobanuro n'amajwi atandukanye.
  • GIF: ku mashusho magufi atagira ijwi. Reba uko wakora GIF ukoresheje videwo.
a.cara-convert-excel-ke-csv.title: Uko wahindura Excel (XLSX) ukayigira CSV, JSON no kubigenza ukundi
a.cara-convert-excel-ke-csv.excerpt: Hindura dosiye ya Excel ukayigira CSV kugira ngo uyishyire muri izindi porogaramu, cyangwa CSV ukayigira XLSX kugira ngo ifunguke neza muri Excel. Impapuro zose zirahindurwa.
a.cara-convert-excel-ke-csv.body:
Porogaramu nyinshi, kuva ku maduka yo kuri interineti kugeza kuri porogaramu z'ibaruramari, zisaba amakuru mu buryo bwa CSV. Ku rundi ruhande, dosiye za CSV ziroroha gukoreshwa iyo zihinduwe XLSX. Byombi ushobora kubikorera kuri I Need Convert.

Excel ijya muri CSV

  1. Hitamo dosiye ya XLSX, XLS cyangwa ODS.
  2. Hitamo ubwoko bwa CSV.
  3. Kanda kuri Hindura. Niba dosiye ifite impapuro nyinshi (sheets), buri rupapuro ruba dosiye imwe ya CSV, kandi zose zishobora gukurwa nka ZIP.

CSV ibikwa ifite UTF-8 BOM, bityo inyuguti nka é cyangwa ü zigaragara neza iyo ifunguwe muri Excel.

CSV ijya muri Excel

Hitamo dosiye ya CSV cyangwa TSV, hanyuma uhitemo XLSX, XLS cyangwa ODS.

Imbonerahamwe ijya muri JSON

Ku bahanga porogaramu (developers), hitamo ubwoko bwa JSON. Buri murongo uba ikintu kimwe (object), amazina y'inkingi akaba ari yo mfunguzo. Ku rundi ruhande, dosiye za JSON, YAML cyangwa XML nazo zishobora guhindurwa CSV cyangwa XLSX.

Inama: Imiterere (formulas) ya Excel ntijya muri CSV, hajyamo gusa agaciro kavuye mu kubara. Bika kandi dosiye y'umwimerere ya XLSX niba ukeneye imiterere.
a.cara-membuat-gif-dari-video.title: Uko wakora GIF ukoresheje videwo byoroshye
a.cara-membuat-gif-dari-video.excerpt: Hindura agace ka videwo ukagira GIF y'amashusho yisubiramo. Ingano yoroheje, amabara akomeza kuba meza, ako kanya muri browser.
a.cara-membuat-gif-dari-video.body:
GIF iracyari inzira yoroshye cyane yo gusangiza amashusho magufi: uko umuntu yakiriye ikintu bitera urwenya, intambwe z'ubuyobozi cyangwa uko porogaramu ikora. Ushobora gukora GIF ukoresheje videwo ya MP4, MOV, WEBM n'izindi.

Intambwe zo gukurikiza

  1. Tegura videwo ngufi, byaba byiza itarenza amasegonda 10.
  2. Fungura I Need Convert hanyuma uhitemo videwo.
  3. Hitamo ubwoko bwa GIF, hanyuma ukande kuri Hindura.

GIF ikorwa ifite amashusho 12 mu isegonda, ubugari ntarengwa bwa pikseli 480, n'amabara abarwa by'umwihariko hakurikijwe videwo yawe. Igisubizo gikomeza gusobanuka kandi ingano ikaba iringaniye.

Inama zo gutuma GIF iguma yoroheje

  • Koresha videwo ngufi. Igihe ni cyo kigira ingaruka nini ku ngano ya dosiye.
  • Irinde videwo zifite kugenda kwinshi kwa kamera.
  • Niba GIF ikiri nini cyane, tekereza kuri WEBM cyangwa MP4. Zishobora kuba ntoya incuro 10 kandi zigakinwa ubwazo ku mbuga nyinshi.

GIF ijya muri videwo

Ku rundi ruhande, GIF nayo ishobora guhindurwa MP4 cyangwa WEBM. Birakwiriye kuyishyira ku mbuga zitemera GIF.
a.apakah-convert-file-online-aman.title: Guhindura dosiye kuri interineti bifite umutekano? Dore ibyo ukwiye kumenya
a.apakah-convert-file-online-aman.excerp: Abahindura benshi bo kuri interineti bashyira dosiye zawe kuri seriveri zabo. Menya ingaruka n'uko wahindura inyandiko z'ingenzi mu mutekano.
a.apakah-convert-file-online-aman.body:
Abahindura bo kuri interineti baroroshya akazi, ariko benshi bakora bashyira dosiye kuri seriveri, bakayitunganyiriza aho, hanyuma bakakohereza igisubizo. Ku mafoto y'ikiruhuko ntibishobora kuba ikibazo, ariko se ku ndangamuntu, amasezerano y'akazi cyangwa amakuru y'abakiriya?

Ingaruka zo gushyira dosiye kuri seriveri

  • Dosiye zishobora kuguma kuri seriveri igihe kirenze icyasezeranyijwe.
  • Seriveri ishobora kwibwa, dosiye zigasohoka.
  • Ntumenya ufite uburenganzira bwo kugera kuri izo dosiye.
  • Gushyiraho no gukuraho dosiye nini bitwara interineti n'igihe.

I Need Convert itandukaniye he?

I Need Convert ikorera guhindura byose imbere muri browser yawe. Dosiye isomwa kandi igatunganywa n'igikoresho cyawe bwite, hanyuma igisubizo kikabikwa ako kanya mu bubiko bwa Downloads. Nta dosiye yoherezwa ku seriveri zacu.

Akarusho: kubera ko nta gushyiraho dosiye, guhindura amafoto n'inyandiko bishobora kurangira mu masegonda make.

Inama zo guhindura inyandiko mu mutekano

  • Ku nyandiko z'ibanga, koresha uhindura utunganyiriza dosiye ku gikoresho cyawe.
  • Siba dosiye zahinduwe mu bubiko bwa Downloads iyo utazikeneye.
  • Irinde guhindura inyandiko z'ingenzi kuri mudasobwa rusange.
a.file-hasil-convert-tidak-bisa-dibuka.e: Igisubizo cy'uguhindura ntigifunguka cyangwa ntikinwa? Dore impamvu zikunze kubaho n'uko wazikemura.
a.file-hasil-convert-tidak-bisa-dibuka.b:
Rimwe na rimwe, dosiye wahinduye ntishobora gufungurwa muri porogaramu runaka. Akenshi impamvu si uko dosiye yangiritse, ahubwo ni uko porogaramu itarashyigikira ubwo bwoko. Dore bimwe mu bikunze kubaho.

1. Porogaramu ntishyigikira ubwo bwoko

Ubwoko nka WEBP, AVIF, OPUS cyangwa MKV ntibushyigikirwa n'porogaramu zose za kera. Igisubizo ni uguhitamo ubwoko busanzwe cyane: JPG ku mafoto, MP3 ku majwi, na MP4 kuri videwo.

2. Videwo yahinduwe nta guhindurwa bundi bushya

Iyo uhinduye igikoresho cya videwo, urugero MKV ijya muri MP4, videwo yigwa uko iri. Niba videwo y'umwimerere ikoresha codec ya HEVC (H.265), ibikoresho bimwe bya kera ntibishobora kuyikina. Gerageza guhindura ukayigira WEBM cyangwa AVI zihora zihindurwa bundi bushya, cyangwa uyikinishe VLC.

3. Dosiye ntiyararangiza gukururwa

Ku dosiye nini, tegereza ko gukuramo muri browser birangira burundu mbere yo kuyifungura.

4. Inyandiko ya PDF irimo ubusa nyuma yo kuyihindura DOCX cyangwa TXT

Birashoboka cyane ko iyo PDF yakorewe scan, bityo ibiyirimo ari amashusho. Yihindure JPG cyangwa PNG kugira ngo ubike ibiyirimo.

5. Inyuguti zidasanzwe muri CSV

Menya neza ko ufungura CSV ukoresheje encoding ya UTF-8. Dosiye za CSV ziva kuri I Need Convert zisanzwe zirimo ikimenyetso cya UTF-8 kugira ngo Excel izisome neza.

Haracyari ikibazo? Soma kandi itandukaniro rya JPG, PNG na WEBP kugira ngo uhitemo ubwoko bukubereye.
